status.description: complete = every spec requirement implemented and gates run. partial = some requirements implemented, others skipped (list them in deviations). blocked = could not proceed. NEVER report complete if any requirement was skipped.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences: what was built and how.

filesChanged.description: Every file created, modified, or deleted. Repo-relative paths. Empty array if none.

gates.description: Self-reported gate results. The orchestrator re-runs these independently; report honestly, a failure here costs nothing but a false green costs a lot.

openQuestions.description: Every place the spec was ambiguous. You were required to STOP rather than resolve a design fork - each one you hit goes here, with the conservative reading you implemented instead. Empty array only if the spec was genuinely unambiguous.

conservativeChoice.description: What you implemented pending an answer.

deviations.description: Anywhere the implementation departs from the spec, including requirements skipped entirely, plus the reason. Empty array if none.

invariantsTouched.description: Which of the AGENTS.md top-8 invariants this change interacts with (by number 1-8), and how you satisfied each. Empty array if none apply.

testsModified.description: Any existing test you changed, deleted, or weakened, with justification. Modifying a test to make a suite pass is a serious finding - declare it here rather than letting it be discovered in the diff. Empty array if you touched no existing tests.

bugLogsCreated.description: Paths of any bug logs created via scripts/next-bug-number.sh. Empty array if none.

leastConfidentClaim.description: The single statement in this report most likely to be wrong, and why you are unsure.

output.description: Real counts, e.g. '181 passed, 2 failed'. Not an impression.

preExistingFailures.description: Failures present before your change if you established a baseline; empty string if you did not.
